section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the difference between the name Shaddai, which relates to worlds, and the name Havayah, which is above relation to worlds, and how this determines whether miracles are clothed in nature or above nature.
section.t: And this is the difference between the name Shaddai and the name Havayah,
for the name Shaddai pertains to worlds as above,
and the name Havayah is above relation to worlds.
And as our sages, of blessed memory, said,
"Before the world was created, He and His Name alone existed,"
that His Name
[the name Havayah]
existed before the world was created because it is above relation to worlds.
Therefore,
even after the world was created,
when the revelation of the name Havayah illuminates in the world,
the manner of its revelation is
(not according to the manner of the world,
but rather)
that the light itself is revealed.
And based on this, we can explain the reason why miracles drawn from the name Shaddai are clothed in nature, and miracles drawn from the name Havayah are above nature
(as above, section 4),
for the light that pertains to worlds,
the manner of its revelation is that it illuminates and acts within the illumination that becomes a source for the existence of created beings,
and therefore the miracles drawn from the name Shaddai, "for My Shaddai is in My Elokut for every creature," are clothed in nature.
And the light that is above relation to worlds
(Havayah),
the manner of its revelation is that the light itself is revealed.
And therefore the miracles drawn from the name Havayah are above nature.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the revelation of Elokus through supernatural miracles is not a filling of a lack but rather wealth, because the light above relation to worlds is not inherently connected to the world.
section.t: And based on this, we can explain the reason why the revelation of Elokus through miracles that are above nature is above and beyond a lack
(see above, section 4),
for regarding the light that pertains to worlds, it can be said that when the light does not illuminate in the world,
the world is lacking,
and when it illuminates in revelation, it becomes a filling of the lack.
But regarding the light that is above relation to worlds, that it does not illuminate in the world,
this is not a lack in the world, since this light does not pertain to it
[and the drawing down of this light is not a filling of the lack but rather wealth].
And since the miracles that are above nature are drawn from the light that is above relation to worlds,
therefore,
the revelation of these miracles is not a filling of a lack but rather wealth.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section raises a question: since the revelation of E-l Shaddai to the Patriarchs is higher than the name Shaddai in creation, how can it be said that only the name Havayah is the true attribute, implying that a light above worlds but still related to them is not true?
section.t: And the maamar continues,
that based on the above, that the revelation of E-l Shaddai to the Patriarchs is above the name Shaddai that was in creation,

for the name Shaddai that was in creation is because "I said to My world, 'Enough,'" and the name Shaddai that was revealed to the Patriarchs is because "My Shaddai is in My Elokut for every creature,"
from which name miracles above nature are drawn
(except that they are clothed in nature),
one must understand even more the precise point
(at the beginning of the maamar)
that specifically the name Havayah is the true attribute,
how can it be said that the light that is above worlds
(and only pertains to worlds)
is not true, Heaven forbid.
